description: Repaints the palette and fonts of an existing site across every section without touching its content or structure - the tool for make it warmer, darker, more corporate. At least one of palette_primary, palette_neutral, font_heading, font_body is required. Free, and no account is needed for a draft you created.

draft_token.description: The draft token returned by draft_create, if you are working on an anonymous draft. Only needed when your client cannot send the x-pagetool-draft-token header.

favicon_url.description: The browser-tab icon for the site: an https:// image URL (or a /path on the site), max 500 characters. May be the only field. Without one, customer domains show the first letter of the site name on its primary colour.

palette_neutral.description: New neutral text/background colour as a #rrggbb hex string.

palette_primary.description: New primary brand colour as a #rrggbb hex string.

site_key.description: The site to theme. Defaults to the caller's current draft site when omitted.

stage.description: true = work on a staged copy instead of the live site: preview it at staged_preview_url, then publish_staged or discard_staged. Omit for a normal (immediately live) edit.

name: set_theme
title: Repaint a site's theme
